title: The limiting oxygen volume fraction for opposed flame spread extinction

source.duplicateCheck: Different PDF bytes; identical extracted text and all nine page renders at the checked resolution. These are not independent sources or replications.
source.rights: Page 1 states Elsevier user license, https://www.elsevier.com/open-access/userlicense/1.0/. No CC BY assumption; PDFs and figures are not redistributed.
source.extraction: Printed methods and model parameters only. No graph measurements digitized.

chamber.gasManagement: Fresh gas supply and exhausted effluents; oxygen is prescribed in decreasing steps, not left to deplete by combustion in a sealed chamber.

flow.deviationInterpretation: Condition-dependent obstruction near sample/heaters; not a measured uncertainty interval or a known effective total flow.

radiation.profile: Radially uniform but nonuniform along the sample; half-Gaussian axial profile

protocol.validityRuleAsDescribed: A stable flame at LOC plus the step resolution, followed by extinction at the reported LOC.
protocol.oxygenCheck: ENERAC 700 measurement of gas flowing into the test section
protocol.historyCaveat: Burning changes the specimen and the front moves within a nonuniform heating profile; constant chamber settings do not establish constant thermal state or local heat flux.

endpoint.intendedQuantity: Limiting oxygen volume fraction for downward opposed flame spread
endpoint.sourceStatistic: Condition-level average of the reported oxygen volume fractions
endpoint.statisticSpread: Standard deviation across tests, not a confidence interval or a complete measurement-error model
endpoint.extraRepeatNote: The authors describe three test points with six to ten additional tests; exact run identities and counts for each condition are unavailable here.
endpoint.reportedResidualFlame: Page 4 describes spread stopping while a blue semicircular flame remains near the top surface.
endpoint.mappingPolicy: Do not automatically map the source's combined endpoint to a single detected-spread, visible-flame or fuel-regression criterion. Do not reconstruct run brackets from condition averages or graph symbols.

publishedModels.parameterRoles: Reference/fitted correlation parameters. The 101 kPa reference is not an additional observed test condition, and 100 kW/m2 is not the applied peak flux range.

publishedModels.scope: Heat transfer, gas kinetics and combined limits are discussed separately. The rods are stated to lie between thermal thin/thick limits; the discussion uses a thick-rod approximation.
publishedModels.unresolved: Section 4.3.3 says extracting the oxygen limit is constrained by difficulty determining equation parameters and is beyond the work's scope. No per-run mechanism label is supplied.

sourceQualifications: LIV24-Q01: Combined source endpoint and residual flame; no unique mapping to full extinction.
LIV24-Q02: Stepped oxygen, unspecified per-run increments and finite holds; no exact continuous physical threshold.
LIV24-Q03: Condition averages and standard deviations do not identify individual run bounds, mechanisms or independence.
LIV24-Q04: Normal-gravity mixed convection and nonuniform radiant profile; nominal flow or PMMA labels do not establish cross-study equivalence.
